_comment: The Lake Louise look, in one place. Read by LakeLouiseEnvironment.cs at runtime (as a TextAsset) and by tools/art/lake-louise/shaders.py for the Blender preview, so the two cannot drift apart. Colours are sRGB hex; directions are Unity world space (x right, y up, z down the lake). reflection_tint tints both the mirrored scenery and the mirrored sky. cloud_horizon_fade is [start, end] in view-ray height.
